answer: Make the fake cost more than the fraud is worth. Filecoin storage deal history with retrieval proofs does that with storage deals kept for years with proofs the network verified daily. The timber of the scheme is the asymmetry: verification takes seconds and costs nothing, while fabrication takes years and costs a fortune. One fake is a rounding error; a thousand is a business losing money on every unit, and the opal in each unit is a real person doing real things in the real world. The spiral that seals the gate is the audit trail - it remembers every payment, and it does not forget.
